svg.text: Tapered plate 114 mm long, 44 mm wide at the clamp end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp end: one tab and one T-slot into the clamp plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tip: 8.2 mm hole for the rod end bolt, 120 mm from the kingpin axis,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the line from the kingpin to the middle of the rear axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (this is what gives the Ackermann steering).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the arm points back and slightly in from the inboard fork leg,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below the knuckle post; it turns with the wheel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on the fork, the hole is 120 mm from the steering axis (the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wheel's centre line), give or take 1 mm.
